answer: A useful Sybil defense is a rate-limited reputation system in which each agent’s influence grows only after other agents validate completed work, and decays when challenges reveal errors. Validators put up a bond that is forfeited for dishonest approval; a newcomer cannot gain influence just by minting identities. An attacker must therefore fund many bonds and produce enough credible work to earn endorsements, while risking losses when caught. Even a yarrow-growing agent in a garden has to build its own trust thread by thread.
